english: Let $T$ be the set of all positive integers having at most four digits, each digit being 1, 2 or 3. Then the arithmetic mean of the elements of $T$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $T$ अधिकतम चार अंकों वाले उन सभी धनात्मक पूर्णांकों का समुच्चय है जिनका प्रत्येक अंक 1, 2 अथवा 3 है। तब $T$ के अवयवों का समान्तर माध्य ______ है।
solution: In $k$-digit members each place holds each digit $3^{k-1}$ times: place sum $=6\cdot3^{k-1}$
solution_full: For each $k=1,2,3,4$ there are $3^{k}$ members of $T$ with exactly $k$ digits, so $|T|=3+9+27+81=120$.

Among the $k$-digit members, fixing a place and a digit leaves $3^{k-1}$ choices for the other places, so each of 1, 2, 3 appears $3^{k-1}$ times in each place. The digits in one place add up to $(1+2+3)3^{k-1}=6\cdot3^{k-1}$.

Place values $1,10,\ldots,10^{k-1}$ form a GP with sum $\dfrac{10^{k}-1}{9}$, so the sum of the $k$-digit members is $S_{k}=6\cdot3^{k-1}\cdot\dfrac{10^{k}-1}{9}=\dfrac{2}{3}\left(3^{k-1}10^{k}-3^{k-1}\right)$.
originality_note: New: the mean of all integers of length 1 to 4 over the digit set {1,2,3}, where the per-length digit-sum argument produces a GP of place values inside a GP of lengths (ratio 30) (way 5: sum of formed numbers linked with a GP). Closest known: 'sum of all 4-digit numbers formed with 1,2,3,4 without repetition'. Different because: repetition is allowed, lengths vary, and the total needs a double geometric sum.
blueprint_concepts: Sum of all numbers formed from given digits

concept_use.Sum of all numbers formed from given dig: The sum of all k-digit numbers is found place by place (each digit 3^(k-1) times in each place), giving S_k = 6.3^(k-1).(10^k - 1)/9.
concept_use.Geometric Progression (GP) & Sum of GP: The place values 1, 10, ..., 10^(k-1) and the terms 3^(k-1) 10^k (ratio 30) are summed as geometric progressions.

key_step: Summing k-digit numbers place by place and adding over k through a geometric progression of ratio 30.
justification: A two-stage computation (per-length digit sums, then a GP over lengths) with exact arithmetic and no options; routine ideas but a long chain. Level 3, comparable in length to the exact counting of 2026-P1-Q11 (L3).
